method: Equal fixed compiled entries, trusted Playwright clicks, actual synthetic local API saves. One warmup page plus recorded independent pages per size/backend; alternating order. One independent diagnostic click counts recreated task rows; the MutationObserver is disconnected for all numerical timing clicks.
limits: Product limits are unchanged: 200 rows per column and 1200 visible rows per board; the 10000-row workload includes other boards in the same document.
Static files fulfilled from exact build artifacts; this is not network download timing.
Handler is measured in a window bubble listener after the app, with committed-output assertion; next animation frame is not field INP or painted-frame completion.
Chromium-only heap is retained JavaScript after explicit GC, not peak/native DOM memory; other engines report no heap number.
Concurrent host load is recorded; no cross-device or universal tail guarantee.
